title: Every class with code in codemother reaches the diagnostic mixin
intention: Every class with code in codemother (ChallengeResult, ConstraintProof, QueryResult, PatternType, UnificationResult) reaches DiagnosticBase, so the every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin sieve reads codemother green and any of them can run a diagnostic report when we get stuck.
why: Measured 2026-11-05: 337b78c2667d's PROVED crossing was refused by codemother's build gate with five every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin findings, cairn/devices/codemother/challenge.py:25 ChallengeResult, constraint_proof.py:24 ConstraintProof, query.py:19 QueryResult, types.py:31 PatternType, unify.py:18 UnificationResult. Parent 339a45cee6a1 queues per-component siblings and none was cast for codemother. Akien 2026-10-27, recorded on 339a45cee6a1: 'everybody must inherit it. that's why it's a mixin'.
traces_to: Law 4 (the rule is enforced by the sieve, and codemother is red under it); Law 9 (codemother's build gate is red until this lands). RULE 1: codemother imports base, a tool, through its public module cairn.tools.base.diagnostic.
how: Add DiagnosticBase as the first base of the five classes, importing it from cairn.tools.base.diagnostic in each of the five files (D1); prove it with cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_every_codemother_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py (D2).
falsifier: Done when cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_every_codemother_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py, under PROVES for 93265f9215bd key 'all', runs green under bin/cairn test --exec: the sieve returns no findings for component codemother; each of the five classes is a DiagnosticBase subclass; PatternType and UnificationResult raise dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError on field assignment and two equal-field instances compare equal with equal hash; each of the five modules imports in a fresh interpreter; and codemother's twelve standing proofs stay green. Hollow: revert the five files to the pre-build commit and the sieve tooth and the is-a-DiagnosticBase tooth red. Wrong intent if inheriting the mixin changes any class's observable behaviour. proven_by = cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_every_codemother_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py.

decisions.text: D1: THE EDIT, FIVE FILES under cairn/devices/codemother. In each of challenge.py, constraint_proof.py, query.py, types.py and unify.py add the line 'from cairn.tools.base.diagnostic import DiagnosticBase' directly after that file's line 'from typing import Any' (challenge.py:14, constraint_proof.py:20, query.py:11, types.py:15, unify.py:12). Then change exactly these class lines, decorators unchanged above them: 'class ChallengeResult:' -> 'class ChallengeResult(DiagnosticBase):' (challenge.py), 'class ConstraintProof:' -> 'class ConstraintProof(DiagnosticBase):' (constraint_proof.py), 'class QueryResult:' -> 'class QueryResult(DiagnosticBase):' (query.py), 'class PatternType:' -> 'class PatternType(DiagnosticBase):' (types.py), 'class UnificationResult:' -> 'class UnificationResult(DiagnosticBase):' (unify.py). PatternSignal and TypePolarity in types.py are not named by the sieve and are not edited. No field, method or body changes. The frozen classes' mixin setters raise FrozenInstanceError, loud, the e8b58520aeb9 D5 precedent.

D2: THE PROOF. Create cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_every_codemother_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py, modelled on cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_every_tester_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py (same shape, _REPO = parents[4], every import of code under test inside its tooth). PROVES = {'93265f9215bd': {'all': 'test_codemother_holds_every_clause_of_the_falsifier'}}. Teeth: (1) test_the_sieve_reads_codemother_green: chdir to _REPO, inspector.every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin({'component': 'codemother', 'dir': 'cairn/devices/codemother'}, Path('cairn/devices/codemother')) == []; (2) test_the_five_reach_the_mixin: issubclass(C, DiagnosticBase) for ChallengeResult, ConstraintProof, QueryResult, PatternType, UnificationResult; (3) test_the_modules_import_fresh: one subprocess per module 'import cairn.devices.codemother.<m>' exits 0 for challenge, constraint_proof, query, types, unify; (4) test_the_frozen_stay_frozen_and_equal: PatternType(name='x', why='y', polarity=TypePolarity.POSITIVE) equals a second built the same with equal hash, setattr(it, 'name', 'z') raises dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError, and UnificationResult(pattern=that, matched=True, score=1.0, evidence=('e',)) likewise equals its twin with equal hash and refuses setattr 'score'. The final tooth test_codemother_holds_every_clause_of_the_falsifier is green only when every other tooth is. The twelve standing proofs in cairn/devices/codemother/proofs are run at build (bin/cairn test --exec each) and must stay green; they are not teeth of this proof. Run: bin/cairn test --exec 'python3 cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_every_codemother_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py', twice. Hollow: bin/cairn test --hollow 93265f9215bd --proof cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_every_codemother_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py.

builder_notes: WHERE: five files under cairn/devices/codemother (one import, one class line each) and one new proof. RUN: bin/cairn test --exec 'python3 <proof>' twice. HOLLOW: bin/cairn test --hollow 93265f9215bd --proof <proof>.
